hints.title: Combined Divisibility Rule
hints.text: A number that is both even and divisible by three must be divisible by six.

hints.title: Filter Multiples
hints.text: Collect all integers in the array that satisfy x % 6 == 0.

hints.title: Integer Division
hints.text: Compute sum of collected integers divided by their count using integer division, returning zero if none exist.

hints.title: Multiple Filtering Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulator without storing elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking divisibility individually for 2 and 3 adds unnecessary branch operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Combines conditions into divisibility by 6 and correctly handles empty edge case.
